sentence: The longer you wait, more expensive the tickets become.
ruleVi: Khung the + so sánh hơn ..., the + so sánh hơn.

sentence: Lan isn't lazy; if something, she works too hard.
ruleVi: Cụm cố định if anything = thậm chí ngược lại.

sentence: The sooner we leave, the more soon we will arrive.
ruleVi: Soon có so sánh hơn là sooner.

sentence: He is, as it was, a walking dictionary.
ruleVi: Cụm cố định as it were = có thể nói là.

sentence: She became, so to speaking, the heart of the team.
ruleVi: Cụm cố định so to speak = nói cách khác.

sentence: The old he gets, the wiser he becomes.
ruleVi: Hai vế đều dùng so sánh hơn: the older ..., the wiser.

sentence: The more money he earns, the fewer happy he seems.
ruleVi: Trước tính từ dùng less để giảm mức độ; fewer dùng với danh từ đếm được.

sentence: The traffic is no better today; if anything, it is more worse.
ruleVi: So sánh hơn của bad là worse, không thêm more.

sentence: The harder you work, the most you will earn.
ruleVi: Khung the + so sánh hơn, không dùng so sánh nhất.

sentence: The less said about the match, the best.
ruleVi: Thành ngữ cố định: the less said, the better.
